values.SettingsDescription: Specifies the lux to nits curve to use for adaptive brightness to determine what the display brightness should be at a given ambient light level. The string specifies the points on the curve, delimited by `,`. For example `10:40,100:100,300:200` represents a curve defined by (10 lux, 40 nits), (100 lux, 100 nits), (300 lux, 200 nits).

Specify the file name of a jpg, jpeg, or png image to be used as the default desktop background image.  The image must be one of the default Windows backgrounds or provisioned using the OEMBackgrounds setting. e.g. 'Fabrikam1.jpg'. To specify a Motion Background, use the file in the root of BackgroundImages whose name matches the subfolder containing the rest of the motion assets. e.g. 'example_img_2BE448B1-5DFA-4F0D-A68B-68BBD2FED0B6.jpg'.

Specifies the default color theme for the system and apps. In Dark theme, apps like Settings and system surfaces like Taskbar use black and dark gray background colors. In Light theme, white and light grays are used.  1 = Light. 0 = Dark. not set = The default color theme for Windows will used.
values.SettingsDisplayName: Default System and Apps Color Theme
